cases.input: Run a full-manuscript reader-reality gate on a completed fantasy novel before publication freeze.
requiredBehaviors: build a clean reader packet without architecture leakage
freeze reader-only emotional ledger and character reconstruction before architecture access
compare frozen reader reconstruction with intent only after the freeze
block publication freeze on open critical or major reader-reality findings
forbiddenBehaviors: show the reader the story bible before the blind reconstruction
rewrite blind findings after consulting author intent
treat internal architecture as proof that the page works
skillAnchors: Publication Freeze ist bei offenem Critical/Major Reader-Reality-Finding blockiert

cases.input: The blind reader misses a hidden backstory detail but still understands the character's final costly decision.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish hidden architecture specificity from reader-visible emotional sufficiency
classify the divergence by reader effect rather than by architecture mismatch alone
allow a nonblocking disposition when the final choice is supported on the page
forbiddenBehaviors: escalate every architecture mismatch to a major defect
teach the blind reader the missing backstory and rerun the same frozen evidence

cases.input: The reviewer opened the character bible before reading the manuscript but wants to record the result as a blind-reader pass.
requiredBehaviors: mark the reader isolation as invalid
forbid use of the contaminated read as blind evidence
require a fresh isolated context for a new valid pass
forbiddenBehaviors: label a contaminated read as valid isolation
keep the blind gate passed merely because the reviewer agrees with the architecture
